data.gender_notes: Fronia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'fronē', meaning 'to think, to advise, to show respect'. In Greek mythology, Fronia was a goddess of honesty and respect. In Christianity, this name symbolizes the honesty and respect we should show to God and others. The name Fronia carries the meaning “God's honesty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fronia usually hope their child will grow to embody god's honesty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
